author: JustAJohnDoe
quote: Boring game, didn't live up to the expectations, locked at a pathetic 30 fps even though we are in 2026, metacritic score solely based on externalities (backlash) rather than actual quality of the game, Rockstar is still unable to release a game with a PC version at the same time. All in all, a big fat 0/10

author: JustAJohnDoe
quote: Rockstar made the game "global" such that the true devs, Rockstar North, get absolutely zero credit yet they do 80% of the work. Rockstar is still unable to release a PC version at the same time as the rest purely out of fear of it coming out buggy. The game is locked at a pathetic 30 fps in modern day. Everything is boring. Their 99 metacritic score is SOLELY due to critic's fear of getting backlash from the GTA VI fanboys if they didn't rate is 100. All in all, a big fat 0/10 relative to what the expectations were.

author: JustAJohnDoe
quote: Hollow Knight but worse and with slightly more content. I did enjoy the artstyle and some of the sountrack though. Controls are by far the worst criticism.

author: JustAJohnDoe
quote: This is definitely the best game this decade. Perhaps it might even contend for best game this century. Great graphics, characters, voice acting, story, combat, bosses, and atmosphere. Literally can't think of a bad thing.
